comments.body:
First USA, then Canada, then Switzerland? What have we done to deserve such intense scrutiny? I dare say, many of the schools above have no direct contact with the military, and they are sanctioned just because they excel in certain fields? I graduated from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT), and many media outlets consider our university dangerous due to the so-called 'Major Defense Laboratories':

* Key Laboratory of the Ministry of Education for Space Robotics (a Class B laboratory under the Ministry of Education's defense-focused labs for Space Robotics Technology)
* Ministry of Education Key Laboratory for Network and Information Attack and Defense Technology (also classified as a Class B lab)

However, if you look at our university's employment report, you'll see that most graduates end up working for private companies like Tencent, Meituan, and ByteDance(parent company of Chinese TikTok), which have no ties to the military at all.
